title: Media uploads unavailable
summary: media-api stopped accepting uploads after several days of stable traffic

logs: media-api ERROR too many open files
media-api INFO upload stream cleanup skipped on client disconnect
deployments: media-api v6.1 deployed four days earlier with streaming upload refactor

runbooks.title: File descriptor exhaustion
runbooks.content: Monotonic descriptor growth ending at the process limit indicates leaked handles. Roll back the leaking path and close streams on every exit.

oracle.root_cause: The v6.1 upload path leaked file descriptors when clients disconnected.
